entities.summary: Avtandil Nikolozis dze Gogoberidze, nicknamed "Basa", was a Soviet and Georgian football player. He was a Grigory Fedotov club member. His son Tengiz Gogoberidze played one game in the Soviet Top League for FC Dinamo Tbilisi.
